description:
**What:** Add comprehensive spec-grounded serde tests for FileNode, FilesRights, NodeType, NodeRole, FileNodeFilterCondition, and FileNodeCapability using hand-written JSON fixtures derived from draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-13. Independent oracles — no test derives expected values from the code under test.

**Algorithm:**
1. For FileNodeCapability: write a JSON literal from spec §2.1.1 example (lines 285-305). Assert deserialization and that all 10 nullable fields (maxFileNodeDepth, forbiddenNameChars, etc.) serialize as null not absent when None.
2. For FileNode: write fixtures for a file node (parentId:null, blobId set, size set, type set, shareWith:null, role:null), a directory node (blobId:null, size:null, type:null), and a symlink node (target non-null). Assert round-trips. After B1 fix, role:None must produce "role":null.
3. For FilesRights: serialize an all-true instance and verify all 6 camelCase keys (mayRead, mayAddChildren, mayRename, mayDelete, mayModifyContent, mayShare) are present. Assert Default produces all-false.
4. For NodeType: assert "file"→File, "directory"→Directory, "symlink"→Symlink, "customvendor"→Other("customvendor"). All round-trip.
5. For NodeRole: assert all 9 IANA values round-trip; unknown string → Other(s) re-serializes identically.
6. For FileNodeFilterCondition: construct JSON with all 23 filter fields populated (from spec §3.2.5). Assert full round-trip. Assert "type" wire key (not "mediaType") serializes correctly. Assert Default serializes to {}.
7. Run cargo test -p jmap-filenode-types.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- All new tests pass.
- No test derives expected value from the code under test — all assertions are against literal strings or values copied from spec text.
- cargo test -p jmap-filenode-types exits 0. Clippy clean.
title: Add spec-audit serde tests for all filenode wire types
